thread:
toni: Quick thread on the playground run history compact view — trying to balance scannability + ability to inspect tool JSON. thoughts?

rav: I'm leaning toward a single-line collapsed summary per run (human summary) with a chevron to expand JSON. saves vertical space for power users.

claire: agreed but add a small tools micro-breadcrumb under the summary: e.g. "OCR · Translate(1) · CallAPI". keep it semibold and low-contrast.

mike: accessibility nit: keyboard users must be able to expand with Enter/Space and have the expanded content receive focus. Also announce: "Run expanded, 3 tool calls" via aria-live polite.

toni: what about inline labels? users often want to tag runs for eval sets quickly. inline edit (pencil icon) that reveals an input on click seems ok if it's unobtrusive.

rav: prefer input to be single-line with autosave on blur and undo via Esc. don't autoshow on hover.

claire: copy tweak: in compact list avoid technical metrics unless hovered. show latency and a small "units used" pill only when user opens metrics. main list stays friendly.

mike: stream behavior: for functions using `stream:true` the list item should show progressive summary (eg: "partially translated...") and a subtle spinner. once finished, replace with final summary and collapse snapshot. maintain accessibility so SRs see partial updates.

toni: edge-case: nested tool calls (tool A triggers tool B) — propose a tiny depth indicator (››) and a preview line like "2 nested calls" rather than dumping JSON. expand reveals full nesting tree.

rav: design note — show param schema inline for function defs but collapsed by default. small chevrons next to each param to expand type details. example schema snippet: 
```
text: string
lang: enum(en,es,fr)
options.timeout_ms: int
```

claire: lighten the visual weight of badges; use high-contrast option for accessibility toggles. keyboard focus ring must be visible around badges too.

uxbot: telemetry suggestion: fire events `playground.run.expand`, `playground.run.inline_label_edit`, `playground.run.stream_snapshot`. include run_id and user_id.

mike: final checklist before mock: 1) keyboard nav 2) screen reader announcements for list changes 3) visible focus states 4) collapse heuristics for long JSON 5) metrics chevron for advanced stats.

toni: great. i'll build two mocks (compact + stacked) and include sample long + nested tool outputs so eng can test. tagging @claire @mike for review. :sparkles:
